title: Run mean-field simulations
action: Implement the self-consistent mean-field solver (N=80, periodic, t0=2.5, λ=0.25, u=0.8) for all conditions: j_f in {0.2,0.3,0.5}, doping=neutral/S=-1/2/S=+1/2, ⟨S^z_R⟩=0.0..0.5 step 0.1. Iteratively solve coupled eigenvalue equations and minimize total energy; store wavefunction coefficients and energies.
description: Heavy simulation step that runs the full mean-field self-consistency loop.

title: Generate energy curves table
action: For every simulated condition, compute the total energy and write a CSV with columns: donor_spin (none|1/2|-1/2), j_f (float), srz_expectation (float 0..0.5), total_energy (dimensionless).
description: Table of total energies for all (donor_spin, j_f, srz_expectation) combinations. The verifier checks structural properties (monotonicity for neutral/S=-1/2, a minimum for S=+1/2 at j_f=0.2, sign trends).

title: Extract polaron spin density profile
action: For FM state (⟨S^z_R⟩=0.5) and j_f=0.3, compute spin density δn_i on each site for doping S=+1/2 and S=-1/2. Write CSV with donor_spin, j_f, site_index, spin_density.
description: Chain spin density profile that must show a localized amplitude distortion of the SDW near the polaron.

title: Compute energy differences
action: From energy curves, compute E_srz0 and E_srz0p5, then delta_E2 = E_srz0 − E_srz0p5 for each condition. For doped cases compute delta_E1 (polaronic level splitting). Write CSV with donor_spin, j_f, E_srz0, E_srz0p5, delta_E2, delta_E1 (empty for neutral).
description: Summary of stability-related energy differences. The verifier checks structural consistency among the reported delta_E2 and delta_E1 (such as positive delta_E2 for neutral, trend with j_f, and the relation ΔE₂(β)−ΔE₂(α)≈ΔE₁).
output_schema: Columns: donor_spin (string), j_f (float), E_srz0 (float), E_srz0p5 (float), delta_E2 (float), delta_E1 (float, empty for neutral).
